description: Figure 1 is a line plot that illustrates the similarity of Hidden States (HSAs) between different language pairs across the layers of the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the model's layers and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," measures the cosine similarity and ranges from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The plot displays four distinct lines, each representing a different language pair: "en&en" (red, solid line), "en&es" (blue, solid line), "en&el" (green, solid line), and "en&bn" (purple, solid line). The red line ("en&en") shows the highest similarity across all layers, peaking at approximately 0.27 around layer 6 and then gradually declining to about 0.10 at layer 22. The other three lines ("en&es", "en&el", and "en&bn") follow a similar trend, with their similarities generally lower than the red line, peaking around layer 6 at approximately 0.25, 0.18, and 0.17 respectively, and then decreasing to values around 0.10 at layer 22. All four lines exhibit a general decline in similarity from layer 6 to layer 16, followed by a sharp increase in similarity from layer 16 to layer 22.
